# /explain

## Purpose

Explain the selected lines, diff, and thread context.

## When to use

Answer the comment's question; without a question, explain what changed, why it matters, and any relevant tradeoffs. Separate verified behavior from assumptions and call out missing context rather than inventing intent.

## Guardrails

This command is read-only. Do not edit code, instructions, or the review description, implement a suggestion, or report lessons. Reply in this same thread.
